Model note: Backbone is a schematic α-carbon-style ribbon arranged as eight helices per subunit (A–H) in the α₂β₂ tetrahedral-like layout of HbA (cf. PDB 2HHB / 1HHO). Atomic coordinates and the T→R motion (~15° rotation of the αβ dimers, plus iron moving into the heme plane) are approximated, not exact.
